quests.title: Hilichurl Justice

dialogue.t: Mimi tomo, Odomu nye! Muhe mani?
Dada odomu! Kundala dada! Kundala zido, mi dada!
I'm guessing that based on your experience over the past few days, you should be quite clear what this one wants. Thanks in advance.
The location is marked on the map. Hope you manage to find what you've been looking for this time!
Odomu tomo zido mi! Mi mani yeye! <color=#00E1FFFF>Aba mosi dada</color>!
<color=#00E1FFFF>Aba mosi dada</color>... If you can't remember what it means, you can just check the handbook, right?

quests.description: You prepare to help a bullied hilichurl to even the score together with Ella Musk. With any luck, this may lead you to some new clues…
